channel.title: Ameba blog
channel.description: Release announcements and articles about the Ameba linter for Crystal.

item.title: Ameba 1.6.0 has been released
item.description: This release adds 9 new rules — bringing the total to 77 — along with a new `--describe` CLI switch, rule group reorganization, and several bug fixes.

item.title: Ameba 1.5.0 has been released
item.description: This release brings 3 new rules, Crystal 1.9 compatibility, several breaking changes and various improvements.

item.title: A new chapter for Ameba: Introducing @Sija as the new lead
item.description: We are proud to announce and welcome Ameba's new lead, Sijawusz Pur Rahnama.

item.title: Ameba 1.4.0 has been released
item.description: This release brings 6 new rules, performance and metrics severity tweaks, colored output, Docker images on GHCR, and more.

item.title: Ameba 1.3.0 has been released
item.description: This release adds 3 new rules, enables `Lint/EmptyExpression` by default, and includes several bug fixes and internal improvements.

item.title: Ameba 1.0.0 has been released
item.description: This release includes a long-waiting autocorrection feature, new rules and several improvements. Check out the release notes to see a full scope of changes.

item.title: Ameba 0.14.0 has been released
item.description: Check out the release notes to see a full scope of changes. Here we will go through the most important changes.

item.title: Ameba 0.13.0 has been released
item.description: A very small release that supports Crystal 0.35.0 and eliminates the deprecation messages which are related to yaml serialization.

item.title: Ameba 0.12.0 has been released
item.description: Check out the release notes to see a full scope of changes. Here we will go through the most important changes.

item.title: Ameba 0.11.0 - New rules, lint in parallel, GitHub action and more
item.description: Ameba 0.11.0 has been released. Here we will go through the main features and improvements which are included to this release. Also, will do benchmarking comparing parallel linting…

item.title: Ameba's internals
item.description: In this article you will find a high level overview of the Ameba's modules, which will help to understand how it works internally. We will cover everything needed starting from source…

item.title: Writing an extension for Ameba linter
item.description: It was announced recently that Ameba is going to be extendable. That means any developer can create his own extension and use together with Ameba's engine.
